summary: V2 Client CAS Invite regression + new-feature tests: 24h expiry, regenerate-deactivates-prior, client-details submit with PAN/mobile/email/consent validation, and import password fallback to stored PAN. Backend pytest 28/28 passed (15 original + 13 new). Public /cas-connect wizard verified end-to-end: Step 0 Welcome → Step 1 Your details (prefill loaded correctly from invite doc) → bad PAN shows toast → valid PAN + consents advance to Step 2 Sign in. Expired invite page renders error card with 'Notify my advisor on WhatsApp' CTA (wa.me URL with advisor mobile + prefilled message) exactly per PRD.
critical_code_review_comments: INVITE_TTL_HOURS=24 honoured for both POST /cas-invite and POST /cas-invite/regenerate. Verified expiry is ~24h via test_create_invite_returns_expected_shape.

Regenerate semantics implemented via update_many({profile_id, is_active:True}, {is_active:False, status:REVOKED}) BEFORE inserting the new doc — atomic enough for MVP. Verified old token returns 410 with detail.reason='revoked' including advisor_name/firm.

ClientDetailsRequest uses pydantic min_length=10 for PAN, so 'BAD' fails at 422 (schema) before the 400 format check — both paths tested. pan[5:9].isdigit()+[:5].isalpha()+[9].isalpha() correctly rejects '1234567890'.
Mobile validation is layered: pydantic min_length=7 (schema-level 422) + custom 'digits < 10' (400). Short mobile '1234567' passes schema and fails custom, test verifies 400.
consent_gmail_access is optional (default False); consent_cas_access + consent_advisor_access are required — 400 returned if either false. Test covers both branches.
Public GET /{token} now exposes advisor_mobile, advisor_email, has_client_details, consents — exactly the fields the frontend needs to render the expired 'Notify Advisor' card and the prefill form.

Import endpoint uses stored PAN (inv.client_pan) as default CAS password. If no PAN stored AND no password override, returns 400 'CAS password required — submit client details first'. Endpoint short-circuits earlier on missing oauth_tokens (covered by test_import_no_pan_stored_returns_400).

Frontend /cas-connect/:token 5-step wizard (Welcome · Your details · Sign in · Pick · Done) renders correctly. Step 1 prefill name/mobile/email populates from invite doc. Step 3 no longer shows a CAS password input (lock message tells client PAN will be reused).

Expired invite page: [data-testid=cas-error-card] + [data-testid=cas-notify-advisor-whatsapp] (href=https://wa.me/<mobile>?text=<prefilled>) renders correctly when advisor_mobile set. Email fallback [data-testid=cas-notify-advisor-email] present in code path when only advisor_email is set.

MFD ClientCasInviteModal source confirms: subtitle 'link valid 24 hours' (line 134), prefill name/mobile/email inputs with testids (146-158), invite-regenerate-btn (line 191), DETAILS_CAPTURED status badge (line 268). Live MFD-page UI round-trip skipped because cookie-only auth did not hydrate the SPA state in headless browser (frontend uses additional token plumbing not via cookie), but the backend regenerate endpoint is fully exercised by tests, and iteration_51 already validated the MFD modal renders under the same session token.
